title: progression
summary: MSUI implements SMSG_LOG_XPGAIN (including the kill-only tail), SMSG_LEVELUP_INFO, CMSG_LEARN_TALENT, and the exact eight-byte SMSG_EXPLORATION_EXPERIENCE. Exploration resolves the packet AreaTable row, always raises the Discovered toast, adds the XP chat line only above zero, and independently plays the race-keyed ChrRaces column-3 SoundEntries jingle.

openItems.text: SMSG_EXPLORATION_EXPERIENCE not parsed - no 'Discovered: <area>' line; the packet is what names the newly explored AreaTable row (the XP itself also rides a separate non-kill XPGAIN)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: opcode 0x01F8 is strictly decoded as areaId+xp; the live handler resolves the exact AreaTable row, emits the always-on toast and positive-XP-only system line, and plays the race-specific exploration SoundEntries kit even when the name cannot resolve. Focused packet/copy/wiring checks pass.
